shared_elements: schematic incised/carved linear motifs on stone
repeated short strokes in a row
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic linear carvings including horizontal banded lines and rows of short repeated strokes (the crew-strokes of B loosely echoing the ridged rows on A's back), but the subjects are wholly different: A is a monumental anthropomorphic figure whose back carries curvilinear motifs, a ring/disc and belt-like bands, while B shows two upturned-prowed boats in profile with vertical crew marks and scattered cupmarks. There is no shared specific motif, relationship or composition beyond generic linear schematism.
